title: Kiichi's Persistence (1257)
problem: The extra hit calls bc_CalculateBleedDamage again. That function contains Master of Pilwizes (and the Pilwiz card), so these do change it, even though the text says effects that affect Bleeding don't. Bleed-only boosts that live in the damage pipeline don't apply, as the text says. Kiichi's Onslaught: not checked.
notes: Community claim: Affected by Master of Pilwizes; general damage boosts apply, Bleed-only ones don't. Evidence: bc_CreatureEndOfTurn: gate @0x140ace8ca / 0x140acea9c; bc_CalculateBleedDamage @0x140acec38; Master of Pilwizes gates in bc_CalculateBleedDamage @0x1406724a3 / 0x14067267a. Fix sketch: Add "except Master of Pilwizes" (T). Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Master of Pilwizes changes it. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "This damage is not modified by traits and other effects that affect Bleeding". Fix: H: the extra hit (bc_CreatureEndOfTurn @0x140acec38) should use the Bleed amount without Master of Pilwizes / the Pilwiz card. vs bugged: weaker with Master of Pilwizes. | In-game test: Persistence's extra Bleed hit is the same size with or without Master of Pilwizes in the party.

release_notes.intended: Bleeding enemies take the damage again at the end of their turn; this extra damage is not modified by effects that affect Bleeding.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, Master of Pilwizes and the Pilwiz card set still changed it.
release_notes.fix: Now the extra hit ignores those Bleed modifiers.
